words.zh: n. 自助餐；（火车内）餐室，冷餐桌（读作/bəˈfeɪ/）；  v. 打来打去；连续猛击；反复敲打，打击，重击（读作/ˈbʌfɪt/）
words.example: The hotel breakfast buffet offers fresh fruit, eggs, and pastries every morning.

words.zh: n. （一块）布；衣料；桌布；织物
words.example: She wiped the spilled water with a clean cloth before it stained the desk.

words.zh: v. （使）徐徐移动；给……开刃，使锐利；给……加边；  n. （悬崖、峭壁的）边缘；边缘；锋利，尖锐；刀口，刀刃；优势；边；边线；【数】边缘，边；【航】边缘
words.example: We stood at the edge of the canyon and admired the view below.

words.zh: n. 山谷，溪谷，低谷
words.example: The village lies in a peaceful valley surrounded by green hills.

words.zh: adj. 辽阔的；巨大的；庞大的；巨额的；大量的
words.example: The vast desert stretched as far as we could see.

words.zh: vi.&vt. (使)融化；熔化；软化
words.example: In spring, the snow begins to melt and fills the mountain streams.

words.zh: n. 冰川，冰河
words.example: The glacier moves slowly, carving deep valleys over thousands of years.

words.zh: n. 驯鹿
words.example: A herd of reindeer crossed the road in front of our tour bus.

words.zh: n. 地区，领土；版图；领域；范围；属地
words.example: Wolves mark their territory by leaving scent marks on trees and rocks.

words.zh: vt. 明令禁止；取缔；  n. 禁止，禁令
words.example: The city council voted to ban single-use plastic bags in all stores.

words.zh: n. 边界，国界；分界；使球越过边界线的击球（得加分）；界限；分界线；球场边界；【财】边界，界限
words.example: The river forms the natural boundary between the two national parks.

words.zh: n. 村舍，小屋；小别墅
words.example: They rented a small cottage by the lake for the summer vacation.

words.zh: adj. 可见的；显然的，明显的；【化】明显的，可见的
words.example: The mountain peak was clearly visible from the roof of our school building.

words.zh: phr. 在移动中；在进展中；在行进中
words.example: The herd of elephants is constantly on the move in search of water.

words.zh: v. 陪伴；为……伴奏（或伴唱）；陪同；伴随
words.example: A guide will accompany the students during the entire field trip.

words.zh: v. 收养；采纳，采用；采取
words.example: The committee decided to adopt a new approach to recycling waste.

words.zh: adj. 酸的；（人）尖酸刻薄的，不友好的；有酸味的；  v. （友谊，局势，态度等）变坏；使恶化
words.example: The lemon was so sour that I couldn't eat it without sugar.

words.zh: phr. 出发，启程；开始做；摆放，陈列；（怀着目标）开始工作
words.example: We set out early in the morning to explore the national park.

words.zh: vt. 保佑，祝福，赐福；  vi. 有幸具有
words.example: The local people believe the mountain god will bless their journey.

words.zh: phr. 依赖……生活；以吃……为生
words.example: Some wild animals live off plants and small insects in the forest.

words.zh: n. 禁止；禁令；阻止

words.zh: v. 禁止；阻止

words.zh: n. 新闻记者；新闻工作者
words.example: A journalist interviewed the park ranger about the new conservation project.

words.zh: n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声；  v. 打喷嚏
words.example: She tried to hold back a sneeze during the quiet museum tour.

words.zh: n. 茶壶
words.example: The old teapot on the shelf reminded her of her grandmother's kitchen.

words.zh: v. 把……称为，贴标签于……；用标签标明；  n. 标签；称号；唱片公司；标记；品牌；公司；【化】标签；【计】标签；【数】标签，标记

words.zh: n. 面霜；奶油，乳脂；奶油色；精英；膏；  vt. 凝成乳脂，起泡沫；  adj. 奶油色的，乳白色的；淡黄色的

words.zh: n. 豹

words.zh: v. 伸展，延伸，张开；夸大；超越；延续；绵延；  n. 伸展，张开；一段时间；一段路程；（土地或水域的）一片，一段；展开，铺开；  adj. 可伸缩的；弹性的

words.zh: adj. 有报酬的，有回报的；有益的；值得的；有意义的；值得的，有报酬的

words.zh: n. 灌木；灌木丛；矮树丛；  vi. 丛生；灌木般丛生；浓密（或茂密）地生长；生密枝；  vt. 加（金属）衬套于；加套管于；用耙耙平（耕地）；以灌木（或灌木丛）装饰（或覆盖、围绕、围住、支撑、标志、保护等）；  adj. （豆科植物等）如灌木般长得低矮的；粗野的；粗鲁的；粗糙但实用的

words.zh: n. 肺；【医】肺

words.zh: n. 自行车；周期，循环；摩托车；【计】周期；  v. 骑自行车；循环

words.zh: n. 走廊，回廊，通道；（沿着重要道路或河道的）狭长地带；过道

words.zh: n. 踏板；  v. 蹬脚踏板；骑自行车；  adj. 脚踏的

words.zh: n. 泉水，喷泉；源泉；人工喷泉；喷水池；储水容器

words.zh: n. 路线；固定路线；途径；公路；渠道；路途；  v. 按某路线发送；给…规定路线【次序，程序】

words.zh: adv. 领先地；向前；提前；（时间、空间）向前面，在前面；  adj. 在前的，向前的；提前的

words.zh: n. 主题；主旨；主旋律；题目；主题思想；  adj. 有特定主题的；  v. 赋予……某种主题

words.zh: n. 主题公园

words.zh: n. 过山车

words.zh: adj. 不可相信的；惊人的，不可思议的，难以置信的；极好的，极大的

words.zh: v. 请求；上诉；有吸引力；呼吁；诉诸；启发，激发；  n. 呼吁；吸引力；请求； 筹款努力；上诉

words.example: The idea of exploring the cave may appeal to adventurous students.

words.zh: n. 海盗；剽窃者；  v. 窃用；盗印

words.zh: adj. 可爱的；值得崇敬的；讨人喜爱的

words.zh: v. 闲逛，漫步；徘徊；蜿蜒；迷路；离题；走失；走神；离散；漫游；漂泊；  n. 闲逛，漫步；游荡；失散；流浪；徘徊

words.zh: n. 娱乐；消遣；乐趣；愉悦；娱乐活动

words.zh: v. 使人发笑；（提供）娱乐，消遣；逗乐；娱乐

words.zh: adj. （范围、程度）极大的；巨大的；庞大的
words.example: An enormous statue of a dinosaur greets visitors at the park entrance.

words.zh: v. 摇荡，摆动；突然转向；使摇摆，使转动，使转向；转弯；朝……打去；荡秋千；  n. 秋千；摇摆，摆幅；转弯；击打；挥动，挥舞
words.example: The children love to swing on the old ropes tied to the tree branches.

words.zh: v. 熨烫（衣物）；烫平；  n. 铁；熨斗；铸铁；【物】铁；铁，铁元素；  adj. 铁的；刚强的；严酷的

words.zh: n. 时髦，风尚；时装；方式；时兴；流行款式；时尚，流行；  v. 制作，塑造；形成，制定
words.example: The artist fashioned a sculpture of a swan from recycled materials.

words.zh: adj. 罕见的，难得的；（肉）半熟的；不寻常的；美好的；珍贵的；稀少的，稀有的

words.zh: n. 蒸汽，水蒸气；轮船；蒸汽动力；  v. 冒水汽，冒热气；蒸；快速行进；蒸发；散发蒸汽

words.zh: adj. 极好的；壮丽的；卓越的

words.zh: n. 水族馆，水族箱，鱼缸；水族馆，鱼缸

words.zh: phr. 到（某个数量）；直到；不多于；（体力或智力上）能胜任

words.zh: adj. 极地的；南极的，北极的；截然对立的，正好相反的；磁极的
words.example: The polar bear's thick fur protects it from the freezing Arctic temperatures.

words.zh: phr. 颠倒，混乱，翻转
words.example: The bat hung upside down from the cave ceiling all day long.

words.zh: adj. 壮观的，辉煌的，华丽的；极好的，出色的；雄伟的
words.example: We had a splendid view of the canyon from the mountain top.

words.zh: v. 展示；显示；陈列；【化】展示，显示；  n. 表现，流露；显示；陈列；展示；展览；展览品；显示器；【航】显示器
words.example: The museum will display ancient pottery discovered near the river last summer.

words.zh: n. 食欲；强烈欲望；嗜好；需求

words.zh: n. 娱乐；招待，款待；文娱节目

words.zh: n. 柱，支柱，圆柱；栏，专栏；长队；列；【财】列；【计】列；【数】列
words.example: She wrote a weekly column for the school newspaper about science discoveries.
